title: 第15章 母鸡凤凰
novel_title: 御兽仙朝：我能设计进化形态
content_zh:
那几张凉饼下了肚，罗影身上，总算回了点暖。

    李子诚抹了把脸，又开口了：

    “影子，这七日，你别折腾着来回跑了。”

    “就住我家去。我跟我爹说一声，挤一挤，地方是有的。”

    他指了指县城的方向。

    罗影捏着空了的竹筒，沉默了一息。

    笑了笑：

    “不了。”

    “我没跟家里打招呼就走了，再七日不回去，我爹我哥，怕是要担心坏了。”

    这是他说出口的话。

    可没说出口的，他心里头清楚。

    李子诚的爹李虎，那间小卖铺的东家，未必待见他这么个拿牛角顶束脩的穷同学。

    寄人篱下，他自个儿尴尬，更要紧的是，夹在中间的李子诚，两头都不好做人。

    这点人情上的难处，他不愿叫这个守了他一夜的兄弟，再去担。

    李子诚望着他，张了张嘴，似是还想劝。

    可瞧见罗影那双虽疲惫的眼睛，到底把话咽了回去。

    他知道罗影的脾性。

    倔得很。

    于是，沉默了一会后，开口道：

    “那......你路上当心。”

    “水带着。走渴了，垫一口。”

    末了，他只把那灌满了水的竹筒，硬塞进罗影怀里。

    罗影没推。

    他把竹筒，连同那份没说破的情，一并收下了。

    他冲李子诚拱了拱手，背起那只空了的旧书箱，转身，踏上了回稻花村的路。

    从县城回稻花村，要走两个多时辰的山路。

    这路不太平。

    去年入秋闹过狼，零星的散狼没清干净，隔三差五还有人在山道上撞见。

    一个十四岁的孩子，独自走这条路，是要担风险的。

    可罗影有他的法子。

    他没走那荒僻的近道，专挑那压着两道深深车辙的大路走。

    他心里头明白，压出这般车辙的，是有家底的商队。

    那样的商队，头里必有一只【瞭远猴】。

    那猴子眼神毒，蹲在高处能望出去三四里地，专挑安稳的路线走，有半点风吹草动，提前就叫唤了。

    纵是当真撞上了凶兽，商队里还养着【铁脊豺】。

    那东西脊背上一排铁灰色的硬鬃竖着，打个哈切野狼都寒颤，又怎敢近身？

    罗影只需要缀在这车辙后头。

    既借了【瞭远猴】替他探的安稳路，又沾了那【铁脊豺】足以吓退野兽的气息。

    便可以最大程度的保持自己的安稳。

    这是他给自己挣来的一条活路。

    只不过......

    路，是真难走。

    ......

    日头一寸一寸地爬高，又一寸一寸地偏西。

    山路坑洼，碎石硌脚，上坡一程接着一程。

    罗影那双磨得快露了趾头的草鞋，底子薄。

    每踩一块尖石，疼痛都直往脚心里钻。

    走着走着，他开始气喘。

    到后来，那喘息声粗得像破了的风箱。

    满头的汗，顺着鬓角往下淌。

    淌进眼睛里...涩得发疼。

    他那两条腿，也和灌了铅似的，越来越沉，越来越软。

    罗影撑着一块路边的石头，停下来，大口大口地喘。

    他低头望着自己那双不住打颤的腿，心里头忽然浮起一个念头。

    “不对...

    我是庄稼人的孩子。

    庄稼人的孩子，打小在地里头摸爬滚打，身子骨，本不该这么差的。

    村里头跟我一般大的娃，哪个不是能挑能扛？

    怎么独独我，走这么点山路，就垮成了这副样子？”

    这个念头一起，三十年的前世记忆，混着今生这十四年的，一并涌了上来，在他脑子里头，翻江倒海。

    翻着翻着......

    他忽然就怔住了。

    他想起来了。

    这今生的十四年里。

    家里头，竟从没让他干过一次农活。

    一次都没有。

    他记起，小时候他也想帮忙。

    秋收的时候，他抱起一捆稻草，才走两步，那捆稻草就被人一把夺了过去。

    是他大哥罗川。

    罗川把那捆稻草往自己肩上一扛，瞪他一眼，沉闷开口：

    “影子，搁下。”

    “这粗活，我来。你回屋看书去。”

    他记起，有一回他爹腰还没伤，在饭桌上提了一句，说影子也大了，农忙的时候，能搭把手了。

    话音没落，就被罗川顶了回去。

    那个平日里闷头干活、不爱多言的大哥，把饭碗往桌上一搁，闷声闷气地，说了一句：

    “让影子跟我干一样的活？”

    “那我这些年扛着，是为了啥？”

    他爹没接话。

    只是默默地，把旱烟点上，一口一口地抽，半边屋子都熏得发黄。

    那一日，他爹下地，忙到很晚很晚。

    月亮都上来了，才弓着那条还没好利索的腰，一步一挪，疲惫地回了家。

    罗影撑在那块石头上，喘着粗气。

    他那双眼睛里，没来由地就漫上了一层雾气。

    随即...

    一颗...

    两颗...

    顺着他那满是汗的脸，无声地滚了下来。

    不是因为苦。

    也不是因为累。

    是因为这一刻，他才懂了。

    他这副走两个时辰山路就垮掉的弱身子骨。

    不是他天生就弱。

    是他大哥罗川那一双手，那一副日渐压弯了的脊梁...

    替他，把该他干的活，一锄头一锄头地全扛了过去。

    是他爹那条直不起来的腰...
content_en:
After eating those few cold pancakes, Luo Ying finally felt a little warmer.
Li Zicheng wiped his face and spoke again:
"Shadow, please stop running back and forth these seven days."
"Just stay at my house. I'll tell my father and squeeze in. There's room."
He pointed in the direction of the county seat.
Luo Ying held the empty bamboo tube and was silent for a breath.
Smiled:
"No."
"I left without saying hello to my family. If I don't come back for seven days, my father and brother will be worried."
These were the words that came out of his mouth.
But what he didn't say out loud, he knew clearly in his heart.
Li Zicheng's father, Li Hu, the owner of the small shop, might not be happy with a poor classmate like him who used horns to fix his hair.
He was embarrassed to be dependent on others, and more importantly, Li Zicheng, who was caught in the middle, was not good at both ends.
He didn't want to ask the brother who had guarded him all night to take on this human difficulty.
Li Zicheng looked at him and opened his mouth, as if he still wanted to persuade.
But seeing Luo Ying's tired eyes, he finally swallowed his words.
He knew Luo Ying's temperament.
Very stubborn.
So, after being silent for a while, he said:
"Then...be careful on the road."
"Take water with you. If you get thirsty after walking, take a sip."
In the end, he just stuffed the bamboo tube filled with water into Luo Ying's arms.
Luo Ying didn't push.
He accepted the bamboo tube and the unspoken love.
He bowed his hands to Li Zicheng, picked up the empty old book box, turned around, and set foot on the road back to Daohua Village.
It takes more than two hours to walk back to Daohua Village from the county seat.
This road is not smooth.
There was a wolf quarrel in autumn last year. The scattered wolves were not cleared away, and people bumped into them on the mountain road every now and then.
A fourteen-year-old child takes risks by walking this road alone.
But Luo Ying has his own tricks.
He did not take the lonely shortcut, but chose the main road with two deep ruts.
He knew in his heart that it was the well-off caravans that created such a rut.
Such a caravan must have a [Liaoyuan Monkey] at its head.
The monkey's eyes were poisonous. He could see three or four miles from a high place. He chose a stable route and called out in advance at the slightest sign of trouble.
Even if they really ran into a ferocious beast, the caravan still kept an [Iron-spine Jackal].
A row of iron-gray bristles stood up on the thing's back. It made a wild wolf shiver, so how could it dare to get close?
Luo Ying just needs to stay behind this rut.
Not only did he borrow the safe path explored by the Distant Monkey for him, but he also got the aura of the Iron-spine Jackal that could scare away wild beasts.
You can maintain your own stability to the greatest extent.
This is a way of survival that he has earned for himself.
only......
The road is really difficult to walk.
...
The sun climbed higher inch by inch, and moved westward inch by inch.
The mountain road is full of potholes and gravel, and it goes uphill one step after another.
Luo Ying's worn-out straw sandals had thin soles.
Every time I step on a sharp stone, pain goes straight into the soles of my feet.
As he walked, he began to breathe.
Later, the breathing sound was as loud as a broken bellows.
Sweat dripped down from his head and temples.
It dripped into the eyes...it was so astringent that it hurt.
His legs were becoming heavier and softer, as if they were filled with lead.
Luo Ying supported a stone on the roadside and stopped, breathing heavily.
He looked down at his trembling legs, and a thought suddenly came to his mind.
"wrong...
I am a farmer's child.
The children of farmers, who have been crawling and rolling around in the fields since they were young, should not have such bad health.
Among the children in the village who are about the same age as me, which one can pick and carry them?
Why am I alone, walking on such a mountainous road, and ended up like this?"
This thought, together with thirty years of past life memories, mixed with the fourteen years of this life, came up and turned upside down in his mind.
Turning and turning...
He suddenly froze.
He remembered.
In these fourteen years of this life.
At home, he was never allowed to do farm work.
Not once.
He remembered that as a child he too wanted to help.
During the autumn harvest, he picked up a bundle of straw and took just two steps when someone snatched the bundle of straw away from him.
It's his eldest brother Luo Chuan.
Luo Chuan put the bundle of straw on his shoulder, glared at him, and said solemnly:
"Shadow, put it down."
"I'll do the rough work. You go back to the room and read."
He remembered that one time, when his father's back was still injured, he mentioned at the dinner table that the shadow was getting bigger and he could help him when the farming was busy.
As soon as he finished speaking, Luo Chuan pushed him back.
The eldest brother who usually worked hard and didn't like to talk much put his rice bowl on the table and said in a low voice:
"Let Shadow do the same work as me?"
"Then why have I been carrying it all these years?"
His father didn't answer.
Just silently, he lit up the dry cigarette and smoked it one puff at a time, until half of the room turned yellow.
That day, his father went to the fields and was busy very late.
The moon was already up, so I bowed my waist, which was not yet smooth, moved step by step, and returned home tiredly.
Luo Ying leaned on the stone, breathing heavily.
His eyes were filled with mist for no reason.
immediately...
One...
Two...
It rolled down silently along his sweaty face.
Not because of suffering.
It's not because I'm tired.
It was because of this moment that he understood.
His body was so weak that it collapsed after just two hours of walking on the mountain road.
It's not that he is inherently weak.
It's his elder brother Luo Chuan's hands and his spine that is getting bent day by day...
For him, he took over all the work that he had to do, hoe after hoe.
It's his father's waist that can't straighten up...
